title: Xiaomi Unveils Its New Beast Worldwide! 📸
body: Xiaomi Unveils Its New Beast Worldwide! 📸
Xiaomi has launched the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max at a global event in Paris: 200-megapixel Leica cameras, an extra rear display, and a huge 7,050 mAh battery, with a Snapdragon 8 Elite processor.
What do you think of the rear display — a practical idea or just a showpiece? 🤔
